listing.name: Marxon Portrait Pack
listing.summary: This portrait pack adds in portraits for the Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenary, Pirate and Player factions. 1.0.1 added Luddic Path, Independent, and Sindrian Diktat Portraits. 1.0.2 added Tri-Tachyon, Sindrian Diktat, and Independent Portraits.
listing.aiSummary: Adds new character portraits for multiple factions including Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenaries, Luddic Path, Sindrian Diktat, Independents, Pirates, and the Player.

description:
Welcome to my portrait pack.

Yet another pack to add to the dozens of ones that already exist.

I recently started playing Starsector again after a several year hiatus from the game. While playing I wanted to add more pirate portraits, but in the process of doing so wound up making some more for a few of the other factions.

This portrait pack adds in portraits for the Tri-Tachyon, Hegemony, Persean League, Mercenary, Pirate and Player factions.
1.0.1 added Luddic Path, Independent, and Sindrian Diktat Portraits.
1.0.2 added Tri-Tachyon, Sindrian Diktat, and Independent Portraits.

Tri-Tachyon: 11 Portraits
The Hegemony: 8 Portraits
Persean League: 4 Portraits
Mercenaries: 5 Portraits
Luddic Path: 3 Portraits
Sindrian Diktat: 6 Portraits
Independents: 7 Portraits
Pirates: 22 Portraits
Player: 3 Unique Portraits (All portraits are available to the player)

Disclaimer:
I used NovelAI to make these portraits and attempted to keep the style as close to the game as possible.

Preview:

Spoiler

1.0.1 Update:

Spoiler

Added 4 Diktat Portraits
Added 6 Independent Portraits
Added 3 Luddic Path Portraits

1.0.2 Update:

Spoiler

Added 4 Tri-Tachyon Portraits
Added 2 Diktat Portraits
Added 1 Independent Portraits
Made Pirate14 slightly larger
Made all portraits able to be selected by the player
Cleaned up the Persean League code. (Not sure why that one was setup different)
